headline: Retrieve who I am, then help me learn from what happens
overview: The protocol surface mirrors the product story. An authenticated search finds official strengths evidence, a narrow profile read preserves its provenance, a private reflection turns that context into practice, and three independent reads plus the real app confirm the write.
targetAudience: Operators deciding whether a Personal OS gives an agent trustworthy, useful context

steps.title: Search finds the relevant self knowledge
steps.action: Searched the authenticated Personal OS for CliftonStrengths.
steps.description: The result connects the canonical profile to a supporting reflection and returns the official Top 5 without exposing unrelated private profile fields.
steps.screenshotAlt: Terminal showing Inner Quest Personal OS search finding the official CliftonStrengths profile and supporting reflection

steps.title: The source travels with the result
steps.action: Fetched the safe strengths and provenance fields from the self profile.
steps.description: The connector reports Gallup, the completion date, coverage of all 34 themes and the user-confirmed transcription, while keeping an earlier partial archive separate.
steps.screenshotAlt: Terminal showing the source and provenance of the official Inner Quest strengths result

steps.title: Context becomes a private reflection
steps.action: Created one clearly labelled private insight through the production connector.
steps.description: The reflection asks how the owner can make their strengths useful in a complex decision, then records a concrete practice grounded in the five official themes.
steps.screenshotAlt: Terminal showing a private Inner Quest reflection created from official strengths evidence

steps.title: Independent reads and the app close the loop
steps.action: Fetched the reflection by ID, listed it by exact title, searched the Personal OS, and opened the same result in My Reflections.
steps.description: Every path returned the same prompt, body and tags. After the visual proof was saved, the synthetic reflection was deleted and a final fetch confirmed it was gone.
steps.screenshotAlt: Terminal showing exact reflection read-back through get, list, search and the Inner Quest app

keyFeatures: Independent get, list and search read-back
The exact result visible in My Reflections
tips: The public transcript contains only official strengths evidence and one synthetic proof reflection; all unrelated private data is excluded.
note: Observed through the authenticated production Inner Quest connector and app. The synthetic private reflection was removed after exact read-back and capture.
